title: Women's Y2K – Gold Star for Leaving the House Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Introvert Zip Up Hoodie – Gold Star for Leaving the House
seo.description: An introvert zip up hoodie: GOLD STAR FOR LEAVING THE HOUSE on the back around a smiling star in sunglasses, plus an embroidered smiling star on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This introvert zip up hoodie is for the woman who deserves a gold star for leaving the house at all, zipped on for the one errand and the quick escape home.

A smiling gold star in round sunglasses stands with one hand on its hip and a set of house keys in the other, in gold, pink, periwinkle and navy with a worn print texture. GOLD STAR runs above it and FOR LEAVING THE HOUSE below in tall condensed capitals, the second line a touch wider than the first: yellow and cream on Black and Navy, ochre and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small five-point star with a tiny smile is embroidered on the left chest, and the words GOLD STAR are stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest smiling star and left-cuff GOLD STAR, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Gold Star for Leaving the House zip hoodie fit?
The Gold Star for Leaving the House introvert zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this introvert hoodie warm enough for cool errand mornings?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool errand mornings, coffee runs and the fast walk back home well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, GOLD STAR above the art and FOR LEAVING THE HOUSE below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small five-point star with a tiny smile sits on the left chest with no words, and GOLD STAR is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The smiling star on the chest and the GOLD STAR cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for an introvert, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the friend who earns a gold star for every time she leaves the house. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
